svg.aria-label: The journey: 2022 learning to build; 2023 first production code at bPlugins; 2023 to 2026 built and owned eight plugins on 50,000+ sites, grew Advance Custom HTML from 6,000 to 10,000+ installs, handed four plugins to juniors I mentored; 2026 AI support for Document Embedder, then My Site Hand; now its first 100 users, TypeScript and Playwright.
svg.title: The journey: 2022 learning to build; 2023 first production code at bPlugins; 2023 to 2026 built and owned eight plugins on 50,000+ sites, grew Advance Custom HTML from 6,000 to 10,000+ installs, handed four plugins to juniors I mentored; 2026 AI support for Document Embedder, then My Site Hand; now its first 100 users, TypeScript and Playwright.
svg.text: Programming Hero for web development, Learn with Sumit for React and Next.js.
First full-stack app: the-smart-tutor-client, from empty folder to live URL.
Joined bPlugins. My first Gutenberg blocks and PHP backends reached real sites.
Started answering support threads for what I shipped, and never stopped.
Built and owned 8 plugins on 50,000+ sites. Grew Advance Custom HTML
from 6,000 to 10,000+ installs, then handed four plugins to juniors I mentored.
Pitched and built AI support for Document Embedder with the Abilities API.
Then My Site Hand, my own plugin: 46 WordPress abilities for AI agents.
My Site Hand's first 100 users, a TypeScript roadmap, Playwright E2E,
and a custom business system for a client.
